# Gadget reference

One gadget slot per ship; **G** uses it. How each gadget plays is in the
[player manual](../player-manual.md#gadgets).

## Gadgets

| Gadget | Use | Energy to use | Drain while on (/s) | Drain while moving | Cooldown (s) | Lasts (s) | Default rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Shield** | toggle on/off | 5 | 4 | – | 1 | – | start + pickup (everyone starts with it) |
| **Cloak** | toggle on/off | 5 | 3 | 3x | 1 | – | pickup |
| **Decoy** | instant | 30 | – | – | 10 | 6 | pickup |

## Gadget parameters

| Gadget | Parameters |
| --- | --- |
| Shield | `self_damage_reduction` 0.75, `energy_per_damage` 1 |
| Cloak | `reveal_distance` 6, `reveal_after_fire_secs` 0.5, `moving_speed` 1 |
| Decoy | `return_fraction` 0.99, `return_speed` 60, `return_max_secs` 3, `return_knockback_per_damage` 0.2, `launch_speed` 12 |

## Shield and weapons

An active Shield cuts damage from your own weapons by 75%. Against enemy fire
each weapon has its own setting (a rule set can override it per weapon):

- **blocked:** the shield pays 1 energy per damage point; the hull never takes damage from
  it, even when the energy is gone.
- **wears it (×f):** the shield pays f × 1 energy per damage point; what the energy cannot
  cover reaches the hull.
- **N% passes through:** that share reaches the hull; the shield absorbs the rest for free.

Knockback is never reduced. The shield drops when your energy runs out.

| Weapon | Against an enemy's Shield |
| --- | --- |
| Scrap Laser | wears it |
| Scatter Laser | wears it |
| Plasma Repeater | wears it |
| Fusion Charger | 50% passes through |
| Corkscrew | wears it |
| Ricochet Arc | wears it |
| Leech Arc | 50% passes through |
| Rivet Gun | 50% passes through |
| Railspike | 75% passes through |
| Scrap Shotgun | 50% passes through |
| Bolt Rocket | wears it |
| Seeker | wears it |
| Quicksilver | wears it |
| Eyeball | wears it |

| Heavy Rocket | wears it |
| Flash Pod | blocked |
| Prox Mine | wears it |
